name: stlscale Engine
shortDescription: Browser-based STL scale calculator that outputs resize percentages for tabletop gaming miniatures.
description: The core tool of STLACCESS. Select source and target scales, choose eye-level or top-of-head measurement, and get the exact slicer percentage. Supports Warhammer 40k, D&D, Bolt Action, Star Wars Legion, Shatterpoint, scale model kits, and display pieces. No file upload, no login, no tracking.
features: Eye Level and Top of Head measurement
Copy to clipboard and save to library

name: Scale Conversion Reference
shortDescription: Searchable database of 45 verified slicer percentages for converting between miniature scales.
description: Complete reference library with conversion percentages for 28mm, 32mm, 35mm, 40mm, 75mm, 1:35, 1:48, 1:56, 1:72, and 1:100 scales. Each entry shows the math, scale baselines, resin and FDM notes, and links to apply the conversion directly in the calculator. Community-corrected through submit feedback.

name: Personal Library
shortDescription: Client-side storage for saving and organizing your frequently used scale conversions.
description: Save conversions directly from the calculator to your browser's localStorage. No account, no password, no server. Your data stays on your device. Quickly access your most-used scale conversions without re-calculating every time.
features: Private — data never leaves your browser

name: Slicer Percentage Calculator
shortDescription: Simple tool to calculate the exact resize percentage needed to scale a miniature from any size to any target size for use in Chitubox, Lychee, or PrusaSlicer.
description: The most straightforward tool on STLACCESS. Enter your current model height and your desired target height — the calculator outputs the exact percentage to type into your slicer. Supports any scale combination, from Warhammer base swaps to upscaling display pieces. Shows the math so you can verify the result.
features: Any source size to any target size
Zero bloat — no account, no tracking
